name: Ray Marching with Secant Refinement
definition: A procedure to detect surface points along rays by evaluating a neural decoder at proposal points, identifying sign changes in occupancy logits, and refining the depth using a root-finding method.
summary: Ray Marching with Secant Refinement detects surface points by combining coarse uniform sampling with sign-change detection to locate volume entry, then refining depth using a secant method.
